queryPlans.name: audit-events
queryPlans.raw:
Index Scan using audit_event_engagement_id_idx on audit_event  (cost=0.42..8.44 rows=50 width=... )
  Index Cond: ((engagement_id = $1) AND (id > $2))

queryPlans.name: export-jobs
queryPlans.raw:
Index Scan using export_job_engagement_updated_at_idx on export_job  (cost=0.42..11.44 rows=50 width=... )
  Index Cond: (engagement_id = $1)
  Filter: (id < $2)

queryPlans.name: audit-high-water
queryPlans.raw:
Finalize Aggregate  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=1 width=8)
  ->  Index Only Scan using audit_event_engagement_id_idx on audit_event  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=1 width=8)
     Index Cond: (engagement_id = $1)

faults.name: disk-full
faults.expectation: write paths fail fast without corrupting earlier captures or exports
faults.raw: evidence writer returned capacity_insufficient before commit; pre-existing rows and bundles stayed intact

faults.name: restart
faults.expectation: interrupted upload/export resumes or fails cleanly without duplicate commits
faults.raw: truncated upload was rejected, then the retry committed exactly one action and one evidence envelope

faults.name: postgresql-interruption
faults.expectation: handlers surface retryable service unavailable responses while the database is down
faults.raw: simulated database outage returned service_unavailable and left the request side-effect free

faults.name: slow-client
faults.expectation: bounded SSE readers are disconnected instead of blocking ingest
faults.raw: reader backpressure caused a disconnect while ingest remained live and acknowledged new actions

faults.name: interrupted-upload
faults.expectation: truncated multipart captures are rejected and leave no committed rows
faults.raw: multipart body ended before the closing boundary; no action row or evidence row was written

faults.name: interrupted-export
faults.expectation: cancelled bundle generation leaves the live engagement usable
faults.raw: export cancellation preserved the live engagement and left subsequent reads writable
